texts.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称，我们犯了个愚蠢的错误，在[From.GetName]沙漠看到的沙海涟漪其实是启动的飞船推进器造成的。

有一艘外星飞船头朝下埋没在沙海中，其断断续续工作的推进系统在上方的沙丘激起了阵阵波涛。看来这玩意已经困在这里有段时间了，它在推进器的作用下渐渐插进了沙丘深处。[Root.GetName]没有能够将此船吊出的设备与方法，[Root.GetLeaderName]建议派遣一只飞船到[From.GetName]，以对其进行发掘。
texts.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the waves seen rippling across the sandy seas of [From.GetName] are, bizarrely enough, the result of active ship thrusters.

An alien vessel lies buried in the sand nose-down, its sputtering propulsion systems weakly agitating the dunes above. It appears to have been down there for some time, slowly driving itself deeper into the desert dunes. The [Root.GetName] lacks the means to excavate the struggling ship, and [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends sending a military vessel to [From.GetName] to unearth it.

label.zh: 这么明显的陷阱，我们可不会上当。
label.en: We will not take the obvious bait.

label.zh: 任何剩余的有机生物都将被消灭。
label.en: If there are any organics left they will be terminated.

label.zh: 极端排外主义 · 排外主义

texts.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]终于成功将外星飞船打捞了出来。

但它是空的，或者可以说，被拆的什么都没剩了。

原船员一定是将不是很重要的东西全拆掉后便弃船而去，留下这艘空壳在[From.From.GetName]沉没。[Root.GetFleetName]的工程师忙活了好一阵子，终于将其能量补充完毕并重启了飞船。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] eventually succeeds in raising the submerged alien vessel.

It is empty. Almost stripped bare, in fact.

Its crew must have abandoned ship before it was left to burrow into the particulate surface of [From.From.GetName], and they took most of the ship's non-critical internals with them. The engineers of the [Root.GetFleetName] have managed to essentially hotwire the vessel, and have replenished its dwindling energy stores.

label.en: A fresh commission for the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] fleet.

texts.zh: [Root.GetFleetName]使用高强度拉索最终成功打捞起了沉没的外星飞船，却同时也听到了其武器系统启动的轰鸣声！
texts.en: The [Root.GetFleetName]'s high-tensile wires eventually managed to raise the submerged alien vessel, only to be met by the recognizable whirring of weapons systems powering up!

texts.zh:
回收行动失败了。[Root.GetFleetName]绕在舰船上的高强度拉索在向上提拉时的瞬间就将腐蚀殆尽的舰体切成了数段。

单独的碎块回收起来还相对容易，但整个飞船已变成了废铁。
texts.en:
The salvage attempt failed. The high-tensile tethers that the [Root.GetFleetName] had wrapped around the burrowing ship effortlessly sliced through the vessel's corroded hull as raising was attempted.

The individual pieces were then relatively easy to retrieve, but the whole thing is reduced to scrap.

texts.zh: 可派一支军事舰队尝试打捞这艘一直被掩埋的舰船。
texts.en: A military fleet can attempt to salvage an ever-burrowing ship.
